caseName: The Man Who Kept Her Safe
title: Dana & Celeste

questions.text:
Celeste left her phone at the studio last night. I'm holding it right now.
She hasn't slept at her own apartment in weeks. Her plants are dead. I checked. 🥲
Who is she staying with?

Right. The guy she calls 'J' before she changes the subject.
She told me he's 'in finance', like that's a whole sentence.
What does Julian do for work?

Okay. A real job title, at least.
She told me once that someone keeps leaving her letters. Then she never brought it up again. 😔
How many of those letters has she gotten in total?

She told me it was 'a couple'.
She wouldn't let me read a single one. Said it would just scare me too.
What did the most recent letter say?
questions.answer: I'M ALWAYS CLOSER THAN YOU THINK
decoys: I see you when you sleep

questions.text:
That's not a love letter. That's a threat. 😳
I know she went to the police after her apartment got broken into. She told me that much.
Who did she tell the police it might be?

That's three hours away. She never once said she was leaving Portland.
She told me she's 'putting in her share' on a house with him. Like it's a dinner bill.
How much money is she supposed to put in?

She doesn't have that kind of money. The only thing she owns worth that much is her half of Northlight. 😤
We built that studio out of one rented strobe and a leaky lease. If she's selling, she's already talking to someone.
Who is she meeting with about selling her half?

onboarding.text: Celeste left her phone at the studio last night. She never forgets it. She's been jumpy for months, and in three days she's moving a lot of money. I need to know what's going on.
onboarding.label: Dana

onboarding.text: Six years ago we split one rented strobe and a terrible lease and called it Northlight & Co. She shoots, I edit. She laughs at her own jokes before the punchline. I miss that laugh.
onboarding.label: Dana & Celeste

onboarding.text: Celeste Moreau, thirty-three, wedding photographer. She notices everything: the groom's shaky hands, the aunt crying for the wrong reason. Lately she flinches when her phone buzzes, and she's stopped telling me things.
onboarding.label: Celeste

onboarding.text: Last week a broker I'd never heard of called asking about 'the partnership transition'. Transition. I have her phone for one morning before she comes looking for it. Help me figure out what she's gotten into.
onboarding.label: Dana

msgs.text: Hi Celeste, it's Julian from the Hartley wedding. Hope it's okay I got your number from the studio card.
Hi Julian! Of course. Thank you for the kind words yesterday.
You made a very tense groomsman cry laughing. That's a skill.
Occupational hazard 😂
Can I buy you a coffee? Not a wedding thing. Just coffee.
Ok. I'm slammed this week though
I can wait.
Had a great time last night. Same again soon?
Me too. I have a wedding that day but I'm free after 9
I keep thinking about your lantern photos. Stunning.
Thank you! That was a long night. Frozen hands the whole time.
Got you something. It's small. Don't laugh.
I will absolutely laugh. Show me.
Pottery mug. Slightly crooked.
Perfect. Crooked is my brand. ❤️
A groom from last fall trashed my editing online today. Late delivery, moody. It's so unfair.
That's rude. You deliver on time.
It stings anyway
Guys like that don't let go. Keep an eye on it.
Weird thing. Someone taped a note to my door.
What did it say?
Nothing useful. Rude, handwritten.
Send me a photo. I don't like this.
Sending. It's probably a prank.
Dinner at 8? I booked the place with the terrace.
Yes! I'll wear the green dress
Of course you will.
Thank you for tonight. Best dinner I've had in a long time.
You deserve it. Sleep well ❤️
Julian. Someone was in my apartment.
Are you hurt? Are you still in there?
I'm in the hallway. Nothing's taken. There's another note on my pillow.
Don't go back in. I'm coming. Ten minutes.
Call the police. I'm on my way.
Ok
Did you file the report?
Online. It asked for a possible suspect and I froze.
Think. Who's been angry at you? The guy from the fall wedding who trashed your editing. Put him down. Better to give them something.
I feel awful accusing someone.
You're not accusing. You're giving them a lead. For your safety.
Ok. Done.
Pack a bag. I mean it. You're not sleeping in that apartment.
Julian...
Humor me. Just till we know it's safe.
Ok. Bags are in your hall. Biscuit is at Dana's.
Your key's on the counter. This is home now 🏠
All my stuff is at yours now lol
Exactly where it should be. ❤️
Coming home soon? I made pasta.
On my way home 🙂
Where are you?
At work, editing
Share your location babe? Just so I can stop worrying.
Sure. Sent.
That woman calling the studio is poisoning you against me. Block her. Please.
Done.
Dinner was lovely. Thank you for making me eat vegetables.
Anything for you ❤️
Think about what I said. Somewhere quieter. Central Oregon. A fresh start, just us.
I keep thinking about it. I saved the three you sent.
It's been three hours. Where are you?
Sorry. Phone died at the print lab.
Heading to Seattle for the client thing. Back tomorrow.
Safe travels! Call me tonight?
Still in Seattle. Client dinner running late, staying over.
Ok. Miss you. Sleeping at your place alone feels weird.
Lock everything. Text me when you're in bed. Love you.
In bed. Love you.
Julian there was another one. At the back door at work.
Take a photo and get out of there. I'm on the first train. Back by noon.
I'm ok. Photo taken.
I'm back. Where are you? Stay put, I'll pick you up.
Do you think I'm being paranoid?
I think you're exhausted and surrounded by people who don't see what I see. You have me.
The Lava Ridge house is still on the market. 4 bed, 3 bath, $689,000.
That number is terrifying lol
Total down payment is $170,000. We split it.
Your half is $85,000, babe. Then it's ours.
Where would I even find that kind of money?
You're sitting on more than you realize.
Tomorrow's the meeting, right? Proud of you.
Nervous. But yes.
Done. They said it's doable.
That's my girl. ❤️
I sent you the wire instructions. Check your email.
Got it. Looks official.
Bank is booked for the morning of August 9, at 11.
Perfect. I'll drive you. Wear something nice.
Where are you? Home for dinner? I miss you.
Still at work, editing. Soon!
Late edit tonight, don't wait up ❤️
Babe? You're not answering.
Call me.
Did you send the Okafor gallery? Client emailed me twice.
Sent last night, it's in the shared drive. Her link expired, resending
Thanks. You're a menace.
Battery count for the weekend. Tell me you have six charged.
Eight. I'm not an animal.
Good. Coffee's on me tomorrow.
Lease letter from the studio landlord. Rent's going up AGAIN
Of course it is. We'll fight it. Bring bagels.
Happy Valentine's to me and my cull lists 🥲
Come over, I'm making soup
Only if there's bread
Biscuit threw up on the camera bag. Fully on purpose.
He's a critic.
Hartley wedding done. I'm dead. Send help and carbs.
Cull tomorrow, 1pm. Bring the cards.
A guest from the Hartley wedding texted me. Julian. Tall, beard, said he liked my work lol
A guest who texts the photographer. Bold.
He's funny though
Funny is a start. Don't forget the cull.
Rose City called, your lens is ready.
Perfect, grabbing it after pottery
Wait, you went on a second date and didn't tell me?
Third. I was getting to it.
I want details. Practical ones. Job, car, red flags.
Finance. No red flags. He cooks.
'In finance' is not a job description. But fine. Cooking counts.
Someone left a letter at my door. Probably nothing.
What kind of letter?
Just a weird note. Probably a prank. Don't worry about it.
Text me if there's another one.
Two bookings came in overnight. Summer is going to be a bloodbath.
I love bloodbaths with deposits
Julian cooked for me again. I may never leave.
Save me a plate.
Someone was in my apartment. Nothing taken. There was another letter on my pillow.
WHAT. Are you ok? Where are you?
At Julian's. I called the police. I'm ok.
I'm coming over.
No, it's fine. Julian's here. I'll call later.
Did the cops say anything?
Filed a report. I gave them a name. They'll look into it.
Whose name?
Let's talk at the studio. Not over text.
Can you take Biscuit for a bit? J is allergic. I'm staying at his place for now, just till things calm down.
Sure. I'll pick him up after lunch.
Cat acquired. He's already judging my couch.
Thank you. Seriously.
You okay? Honestly.
Honestly? Tired. J is taking really good care of me.
Biscuit sat on the keyboard and deleted ten minutes of edits. Want him back?
Ha. Keep him. For now.
Some woman called the studio landline asking for you. Said she's family. Wouldn't leave a name.
Don't pick up if she calls again.
I'm not your secretary. But ok. Who is she?
Nobody to worry about. Please just let it ring.
...Fine.
She called again. Asked if you were okay. Hung up before I could say anything.
Let it go to voicemail.
We're starting over somewhere quieter. J and me.
We? Define quieter.
Out of the city. Not decided yet. Don't make that face.
I'm making the face. You can't see it.
Another one. At the studio. J's out of town, I'm fine.
Where? Do you want me to come in?
No. I'm fine. Honestly kind of glad J wasn't here to see it. He'd freak.
Send me a pic.
No. It'll just scare you too.
Lock the door behind you.
June invoices are done.
You're a hero.
New ramen place near the studio. Lunch?
Can't, J is expecting me.
J and I are doing a house. I'm putting in my share. Basically a dinner bill with more zeros lol
A HOUSE. Celeste.
Don't start. I'll tell you more later.
You've missed the last two culls. Everything ok?
Just busy. I'll catch up.
If I ever text you something weird, don't ignore it ok?
Weird how?
Just don't ignore it. Even if I say I'm fine.
Ok. Now you're scaring me.
Don't be. Probably nothing. Love you.
Anna Kerr wants the album consult on the morning of August 9. You in?
I have a bank thing that morning, can't do the Kerr consult. Can you take it?
A bank thing. Fine, I'll take it. Everything ok?
Yeah. Just paperwork. I'll tell you after.
I'm out. Lock up when you leave.
Will do. Almost done with the Kerr set.
Clay & Kiln: Your pieces from the last firing are ready for pickup
Thanks! I'll swing by this week
Clay & Kiln: Your glazed pieces from the last session are ready for pickup on the shelf by the front desk.
Thanks! I'll swing by this week.
Reminder: summer session starts soon. Spots are limited
Can I join mid-session if I miss the first class?
Yes, we can prorate. Just let us know
Please sign me up then. Pay at the studio?
All set. See you soon
Clay & Kiln: New session registration is open. Spots fill fast!
Your glazed pieces are out of the kiln and ready for pickup!
Yay! Can I pick them up this evening?
Sure, we're open until 8 PM.
Open studio hours are extended this month, drop-ins welcome.
Great, I might come by
Reminder: your class is tomorrow at 6:30 PM. Wheel throwing, level 2.
See you there
New glazes are in this month. Come check out burnt honey and sea salt
Sounds lovely, I'll stop in next week
We'll save you a shelf slot
New fall class schedule is up on our website. Early bird pricing ends soon.
Thanks, I'll take a look
Your forgotten mug is still on the shelf, we'll hold it for another month 🙂
Hi Celeste! It's Nora Castellano, we spoke at the bridal expo. Do you still have June 27?
Hi Nora! Yes, still open. Tell me about the day
Garden ceremony in Sellwood, 80 guests, dinner under string lights
That sounds dreamy. Have you thought about timeline? Sunset is about 9
We hadn't! Is that late for photos?
Perfect for portraits. Golden hour dinner shots are my favorite
OK I'm sold. Send the package info?
Sending now. Check your email
Got it! My fiancé Paolo says the 8 hour package is perfect
Great choice. I'll hold the date for 48 hours until the deposit
Deposit sent!! 🎉
Received! You're officially booked 🥂
Question: can we do a first look? Paolo is nervous about crying
Crying is encouraged. A first look gives you private time to do it
OK first look. Where do you recommend?
Under the big maple by the garden path. I'll check the light when I scout
Is it weird if my dog is in the ceremony?
Not weird! What's his name?
Pretzel. A corgi. He has a tiny bow tie
Okay I'm obsessed. He's getting a portrait session
😭 thank you
Did you watch the finale?? I'm still mad
Not yet, no spoilers!!
Okay okay. Just know the dog survives
That's the only thing I care about
Hi Nora, shot list time! Please add any must-have family photos
Sending a list tonight. My family is big, 14 cousins
We'll do big group first, then smaller combos. Ask someone to wrangle cousins
My Tía Rosa will wrangle. She is terrifying in a good way
Perfect. Every wedding needs a Tía Rosa
Farmers market tomorrow morning? They have the peaches again
I wish. Wedding setup at 8
Boo. I'll buy you a basket
You're the best
Peaches are in my fridge when you want them. Come get them
I'm swamped this week. Can you hold them until the weekend?
They'll be jam by then 😂
Then jam it is
Tomorrow!!! I can't sleep
Deep breaths. Drink water, eat a real breakfast. I'll see you at 2 for getting-ready shots
Okay. Thank you for being calm for me
That's my job. See you tomorrow ❤️
Thank you for everything. It was magic. Pretzel stole a dinner roll 😂
I got that on camera, you're welcome. Sneak peek in a few days
Paolo's mom saw the sneak peek and cried
Best compliment. Full gallery coming in about 3 weeks
My landlord is selling the building. Send good vibes
Ugh, I'm sorry. Do you know how long you have?
Ninety days minimum, apparently. Already scrolling listings
Let me know if you need a hand packing
You hate packing
I hate it less than I love you
Cheesy. Accepted
Do you want the leftover lemon bars? I made way too many
Yes!! Drop by the studio, I'm there till late
On my way. Do you need anything else? Coffee?
Just the lemon bars. And your face
Cheesy. Love it
Those were unreal. I ate three before Dana noticed
Recipe is on the way. Zest the lemons FIRST, don't be like me
Noted
Are you coming to book club? We're doing that novel about the lighthouse
I haven't finished it. I'm on chapter 9
Chapter 9 is where it gets good. Come anyway, there's wine
Wine is persuasive. Let me see how the week goes
You always say that and then skip 😒
I know. I'm sorry. Things are weird lately
Weird how? Good weird?
Busy weird. I'll tell you over wine
Okay. I'm holding you to it
Any news on the gallery? No rush!! Just excited
Almost done. Dana's finishing the edits. Tomorrow I'll send the link
GOT IT. Looking through right now
I'm crying at my desk at work
That's the right reaction 😊
My sister's in town, we're hitting the Saturday market. Want to join for a bit?
I have a wedding. Say hi from me!
Will do. Sunscreen!!
Can we order an album? 30 pages, linen cover
Absolutely. I'll email the layout options
Saw a flyer for a ceramics sale at the school on Sunday. Want to go?
Perfect, thank you!!
Wore it. Still pink 😭
Aloe. Fridge-cold. Trust me
Thank you 🙏
Thinking of you. Text me if you need anything, even dumb stuff
Will do. Love you
Celeste, Hector here. We're both booked at the Delgado wedding in May. You want to sync on timeline?
Yes please. Can you send me your drone plan? Venue has a no-fly zone near the river
Just the ceremony from the bluff, 4 minutes max. I checked the permit
Great. I'll stay out of your frame during the vows
You always do. Some photographers I won't name stand right in front of my lens 😅
Not me. Promise
Timeline update from the planner. First look moved to 3:30
Saw it. That gives us golden hour for portraits, nice
Do you have an extra lav mic? Mine died on the last job
Don't have one, sorry. Try Rose City Camera Rentals
Good idea. Thanks
Hey, nice work today. The vows were rough, I was crying behind the camera
Same lol. The father-of-the-bride toast destroyed me
I'll have a teaser for you in a week. Want to send me your best three stills for the reel?
Will do, Dana's sorting them
Teaser is up. Link: private vimeo, password is 'lilac'
Watching now. The bluff shot is unreal
Told you. Drone saves lives
Your second light stand is still in my garage lol
Keep it for now, I'll grab it when I'm by
Cool. Want to do the weekend session? Couple wants rooftop shots
Depends on the weather. Rooftops and wind don't mix
Forecast says calm. Fingers crossed
That rooftop was amazing. Look at this sky
Tell me about it. Sunset did all the work
Another one to ask. Are you doing the Alder Creek wedding in July?
Yes, with Ravi as second. Are you in?
Yes. Planner says the barn has bad Wi-Fi so download everything before
Noted. Offline shot list it is
Taco Tuesday at my place? Bring a friend
I'll try. Thanks for the invite
You say that every time 😄
Next time, promise
Oh and my invoice was sent. Net 15 like always
Got it. Dana will process it
Barn day. Where are you parked? I can't find the gravel lot
Past the red tractor, behind the big oak
Found it. Wow, that's a lot of hay bales
Perfect backdrop though 😂
Great day. Dana told me you've been working too hard. Eat something
Ha. I ate three tacos last night, I'm fine
Need a recommendation for a good flash trigger. Budget is low
Godox X2T. Cheap and reliable
Ordered. You rock
Okay good. Next job: late August, couple from Hood River
I'll check my calendar and confirm with you by the end of the week
No rush. Also new stabilizer arrived, finally
Yay, the shaky era is over
Light stand's still here btw
Belmont Property Management: Hello Celeste, your lease renewal packet was emailed. Please sign within 14 days.
Got it, signing tonight. Is the rent staying the same?
There's a 3% adjustment starting May 1. Details are on page 2.
Okay, that's fair. Sent back
Received, thank you! Your renewal is complete.
Reminder: we're doing annual smoke detector checks. A technician will be at your unit on March 20 between 10 AM and 2 PM.
I'll be at a shoot. Can he come when I'm out? Lockbox is fine
Yes, we have your permission to enter. Thanks!
The kitchen faucet is dripping again. Third time this year
Sorry about that. We'll send our plumber. Any days that work?
Anything after the 10th
Plumber scheduled for the 14th, morning window. He'll replace the cartridge.
Thank you
Your rent payment for May was received. Thank you!
Your rent payment for June was received. Thank you!
Hi Celeste, the building will have water shut off for pipe work on June 9, 9 AM to noon. Fill a few jugs ahead of time.
Thanks for the heads up. I may not be around, is that ok?
Totally fine, no access to your unit is needed.
Hello, this is a notice that the building's water will be shut off for maintenance tomorrow between 9 AM and noon.
Thanks for the notice. Is the laundry room also affected?
Yes, laundry will be unavailable during that time as well.
A package for you was left at the office, a box from a camera store. Pick up during business hours.
Thanks, can I get it later this week? I'm out of the neighborhood for a bit
Sure, we'll hold it for 10 days.
Rent reminder: July rent is due on the 1st. Pay through the resident portal.
Already scheduled. Thanks
Your rent payment for July was received. Thank you!
Payment received. Thank you!
Hi, is your parking space #14 in use? A neighbor says a car with no plates has been parked in it
Not mine. My car's at a different lot right now. Please tow it if it's not registered
Will do. Thanks for confirming.
The new bike rack is installed by the east entrance. Please register your bike at the office.
Gutters will be cleaned on July 22. No need for anyone to be home.
Got it
Rent reminder: August rent is due on the 1st.
Your rent payment for August was received. Thank you!
Reminder that mailbox keys are being replaced. Stop by the office with your old key.
Will do this week
Reminder: the annual smoke detector inspection is next week. We'll leave a notice if no one is home.
Hey Theo, are you free on March 28? Barn wedding out in the Gorge, ceremony at 4
Checking. Yes, I'm free. Same rate as last time?
Same rate. Plus gas, it's an hour out
Deal. Do I need the 70-200 or are you bringing yours?
Bring yours, mine's going to be on the 35 all day
Cool. Charging every battery I own tonight 🔋
Lol same
Weather says 40% rain tomorrow. Should I pack the rain covers?
Yes. And a towel. Last time you dried your lens with your shirt
That shirt had it coming
You at the barn yet? Coordinator says first look is moved to 3
Here. Parked by the goats. There are goats
Get a goat photo for the couple, they'll love it
Already on it 🐐
Great work yesterday. Sending cards to Dana tonight
My cards are in the mail slot of the studio, labeled. Shoot me the invoice whenever
Will do today
Hey, quick one, can I borrow the 85 for a portrait gig this weekend?
Yes. Dana's at the studio until six, grab it from her. Bring it back clean
You're the best. I'll bring coffee
Oat latte. You know the order
I know the order
Landed a gig shooting a brewery's menu photos. Terrifying but paying
Congrats!! Use window light, skip the flash
Window light, noted. Any tips for beer foam?
Cold glass, pour slow, shoot fast. It dies in 30 seconds
Okay I wrote that on my hand
Are you available on June 13? Garden wedding, 150 guests, two photographers needed
Booked. Put me on the calendar
Done. I'll send the shot list in a few days
Do you want me on the groom's side again?
Yes, groom prep then ceremony from the back left
Can you do a second shooter on the 14th of next month? Barn wedding, 150 guests
Let me check my calendar. What's the pay?
Same as last time, plus travel
I'm in. Send me the timeline when you have it
Will do. Bring the 35mm, the barn is dark inside
Obviously 😄
That went well. The grandmother who cried through the entire vows, I got every one
Those are the ones they keep. Nice work
Uploading the cards now. 1,900 frames, sorry Dana
She'll survive. She'll complain, but she'll survive 😂
Timeline's in your email. Ceremony 4:30, golden hour portraits right after
Got it. Is the venue okay with flash during the vows?
No flash. Officiant was weirdly strict about it
Fine by me, I hate it anyway
Did you see the new Fuji firmware notes? They finally fixed the autofocus hunting
Reading them now. I'll update the spare body first and see
Smart. Never update the one you shoot with the night before
Lesson learned the hard way 😅
My camera is making a clicking sound on the shutter. Fuji repair center says two weeks
Ugh. You can use my backup body for the next shoot
Seriously? You're a lifesaver
Pick it up at the studio. It's in the grey case
Lunch tomorrow? That taco truck on Division is back
Can't tomorrow, edit deadline. Next week?
Deal. I'll bring napkins for your hands this time
One time. That was ONE time
Twice. I have photos
That was a good day. The groom's grandma cried at every single photo
Best subject ever. I got her laughing at the cake
Sending you my keepers tonight
Thanks. I'll swap mine tomorrow, cards are still dumping
Do you still have that 70-200 lens? I might need to borrow it for a Saturday
Yep. Come grab it anytime, it's in the closet
You're the best. Coffee on me
Oat milk latte, extra hot, I know
That's MY order
I've been stealing it for years
Heat advisory this weekend. Bring water for outdoor shoots
Already packed a cooler. And a tiny fan for the second shooter 😂
Send help if the bride cries into a lens
Lens cloth is my best friend
Got the lens. Thank you, truly
Anytime. How was the shoot?
Gorgeous light, 96 degrees, nobody fainted. Win
Low bar, high victory
Anyone got a spare NP-W235? Mine's cooked
I have two. Come by the studio
You're a lifesaver. Coffee on me
Oat latte, large
Always
Dropped it at the front desk. Battery's in a ziploc, don't lose it 😅
Backup body is back in the grey case, battery charged. Thanks again
Perfect, thank you!
Taco truck on Tuesday?
Let me check and I'll text you tomorrow
Hi Celeste, it's Rowan Pierce, the DJ. Cedar & Vine mentioned you for a June wedding?
Hi Rowan! Yes, I'm shooting the wedding on June 20. Wanted to coordinate the reception timeline
Perfect. I usually announce the grand entrance at 6:45, then dinner music, first dance at 8
Can you give me a heads up before the cake cutting? I need a clean angle
Of course. I'll make an announcement and wait 30 seconds
You're a dream. Most DJs just blast Mr. Brightside
That song is a weapon. I only use it when asked
Do you do uplighting too? Couple wants a warm amber look
Yes, 12 LED uplights, warm amber is my favorite setting. Looks great on skin tones
Perfect for photos then
Are you coming to book club? We're reading the one about the lighthouse
I haven't finished it. I'm on chapter nine
Nobody's finished it, we'll mostly drink
Then I'm in 😄
That was fun. Next pick is yours
Something short with a happy ending, please
Demanding
Setup at 2:30 on the day. I'll bring cables to tape down so nobody trips
Love that. See you there
Great night. Photos of the dance floor are going to be wild
They are. The grandma on the dance floor is gold
She requested Earth, Wind & Fire three times. Respect
Can you send me your playlist export? I like to use some tracks in my editing sessions
Ha, sure. I'll share the Spotify link, it's 'Dance Floor Rescue'
Found it. Saved
I have a wedding in Astoria next month. Know any good photographers? Mine cancelled
That's your wedding or a client's?
A client's. Their shooter dropped out. They're panicking
Try Ravi Menon, he's great and available
You're a hero. Passing along his number
He's booked. Thank you!! 🙌
Yay. Tell them I said congratulations
Did you see the exhibition at the Art Museum? The photo section is great
Not yet. I'm saving it for a quiet afternoon
Go soon, it ends this month
Adding it to my list
Quick one. Do you have any shots of the dance floor from the June wedding I can use for my site?
Sure, send me an email and I'll pick three. Credit line required
Naturally. 'Photo by Northlight & Co'
Perfect
Book club is at mine next time. I'm making lemon bars
I'll try to come. Not sure about my schedule
Lemon bars will keep
You're too kind 💛
Heads up, I have a free date in September if you need a DJ referral for anyone
Good to know. I have a couple who might want one
Send them my way. I'll throw in a free hour of dance time
They'll love that
Thanks for being so easy to work with. Rare in this business
Hey Celeste, it's Ravi. Dana gave me your number. Still looking for a second shooter this spring?
Hi Ravi! Yes, actually. Do you have full frame bodies?
Two. A7 III and an older one as backup. 35 and 85 primes plus a 70-200
Perfect. I have a ceremony on April 11 at an orchard out past Hood River. Long day, 11 to 9. $350 flat?
Works for me. Do you want me on the groom side or roaming?
Groom prep, then roam during cocktail hour. I'll send a shot list the night before
Great. Should I bring a flash or are you shooting natural?
Bring one. Reception hall is basically a cave
Shot list is in your email. Call time is 10:30 at the orchard gate. Wear black, no logos
Got it. Leaving at 8 to beat the gorge traffic
Good call. Bring snacks, the caterer is slow
I'm at the gate. Is the bride's dad the guy in the orange vest?
That's the groom's uncle, he runs parking lol. Dad is the tall one in the grey suit
Ha ok. Found him
Thanks again for yesterday. You were great with the grandparents
Anytime. Sending you my cards tonight. About 1,900 frames, I culled a bit
Dropbox link works? Dana wants to start on them
Uploading now, should be done by lunch
Paid you via Zelle just now. Check?
Got it, thank you!
Hey, are you free for a June wedding at a farm in Dundee? Might need you for a full day again
Yes! Sending my calendar. I'm open the whole month except the 13th
It's the 20th. Locking you in
Quick q, did you ever fix the back button focus thing on your Fuji? Mine's doing something weird
Mine was in the menu under AF/MF settings. Instant AF setting. Take a screenshot of yours and I'll look
That was it. You're a lifesaver
Did the proofs for the Chen engagement go out?

Can I get a print of the one under the oak tree?

Pay me when it arrives
Sorry I've been slow to text back. Crazy few weeks

Heads up, forecast says 96 on the 20th. Bring water and a hat
Ugh. Thanks. I'll tell the couple to push the ceremony to 5
That was a gorgeous light at the end. The sparkler exit shots look unreal

The print came in. It's gorgeous
Picking it up tomorrow, thank you!
Haha yes. I'm free for the one at the vineyard next month too
I'll check with Dana and let you know this week
Happy birthday week! Dinner on me when you're back in town
I'll hold you to it 🎂
Know any good lens cleaning kits? Mine is trash
The Lenspen with the carbon tip. Cheap and it works
Ordering now
Sounds good. Let me know whenever
Celeste!! The album arrived. I cried in the hallway
Yay!! I was hoping you'd love it. Linen cover okay?
Perfect. My mom wants three copies lol
I'll send the print lab reorder form. Parent albums are smaller and cheaper
Amazing. Also, we're expecting!! 🥹 Due in October
WHAT. Congratulations!!! I'm so happy for you both
Would you do a maternity session? Casual, nothing fancy
Of course. Friend rate, free. Let's do it around 30 weeks
You're the sweetest. I'll text you when I'm ready
Do you have a favorite spot for outdoor portraits? Thinking of the rose garden
The roses will be gorgeous by late June. Or Mt. Tabor at sunset
Tabor. Hills are good for my legs lol
Ha. We'll go slow
Um, are you ok? I texted twice about the shoot and didn't hear back
I'm so sorry!! Phone's been a mess. Yes, let's lock a date
I'm 30 weeks on the 27th of June. Does that work?
Works. Golden hour is around 7:30. Meet at the top by the reservoir
Perfect! Marcus is bringing a blanket and snacks
Birthday brunch for me on the 12th, you better come
Wouldn't miss it. Where?
The place with the lavender pancakes on Division
Say less 🥞
Thank you for coming! The candid you took of me blowing out the candle is my new lock screen
I'll send you the full set tomorrow
You're an angel
Aww the photos are in. Preview gallery sent 🥹
I'm bawling. I look like a goddess. How did you do that
You were glowing, I just pressed the button
Stop. We're making the Mt. Tabor one a canvas for the nursery
I'll prep a print-ready file
Can you recommend a good dentist? Mine retired
I go to Portland Dental Care, they're gentle
Booked. Thanks!
Do you want to come to the baby shower? It's in late August at my mom's
I'd love to. Send details?
Will do. Also, we picked a name!! Not telling yet 🤐
Cruel!! Hint?
It's after my grandma. That's all you get
I'll figure it out
Haven't heard from you in ages, everything alright?
All good. Just heads down with work
Okay. Love you, text me when you surface
Will do. Love you too
Gift registry link is on the invite. No pressure
Got it. I'm buying the muslin blankets, they're my favorite
Perfect, thank you. Also craving pad thai nonstop
Baan Thai is the answer. I'll send you a pickup 😄
You're an angel ❤️
Sending you a playlist for your editing marathons
Hawthorne Pharmacy: Your prescription refill is ready for pickup
Thank you, I'll pick it up after lunch
Reminder: pick up your order by end of week or it will be returned to stock
Picking it up today, sorry
No problem. We'll have it ready at the counter
Hawthorne Pharmacy: Your prescription is ready for pickup. Open until 7 PM today.
Hawthorne Pharmacy: Reminder, your prescription is still waiting for you. Reply STOP to opt out.
Hawthorne Pharmacy: Flu shots now available, no appointment needed
Good to know, thanks
Your order is ready: allergy tablets and vitamins
Celeste!! Did you sign up for the spring wheel throwing session?
I did! Tuesday nights again. Are you in?
Signing up now. Last time I made a bowl that looked like a hat
I loved the hat bowl. Keep it
Lol it holds my keys now. Very functional
Did you pick up your glazed mugs yet? Mine are ready
Not yet. The speckled white ones? Mine came out better than expected
Yes! Mine turned greenish instead of blue. Whatever, I love it
Cute. Want to grab coffee after pickup? The place with the oat cortados
Can't today, editing deadline. Rain check?
Always. Good luck
Hey, Kayla's having a housewarming and wanted to invite you. Next month!
Aw, I'd love to but I have a wedding that day. Tell her congrats
Of course you do. Pottery mugs are my gift, I'll add your name to the card
You're the best
Missed you at class last night. Wheel #4 was empty
Sorry!! Got stuck at work. I'll be there next time
Teacher said we're doing handles next. Prepare to suffer
Is the sourdough class still on for the 20th?
Yep. I'm in. Do we bring our own starter?
They provide it. Just bring an apron and a jar
Okay okay 🍞
Hello? Are you alive? Haven't heard from you in a bit
Alive! Just buried in weddings and edits. So sorry
Okay good. I miss you at class. Come to the studio sale next week? There's a seconds shelf
I'll try. Save me a small vase if you see one
My starter died. RIP Doughlores
Doughlores 😭 gone too soon
I'm starting a new one. Name suggestions?
Loafy Fitzgerald
Perfect, done
Got you a tiny one with a crooked neck. It's perfect and ugly
Ha! Hold it for me. I'll swing by soon
I'll leave it at the front desk with your name on a sticky note
Thank you. Truly
Loafy is bubbling! Look at him
So proud. Will you sell me a jar of it?
I'll give you a jar for free
We should do a pottery night, just us. Wine, no wheel
I want that. Things are a little weird right now but soon
Weird how? You ok?
Just busy, I'm fine ❤️
Okay. Door's always open. Bring a snack
Hope you're doing okay. Haven't seen you around the neighborhood
I'm good, just busy. Wedding season
Okay. Bread is waiting whenever 🙂
New glazes are in. There's one called 'burnt honey'. Very you
Okay that sounds amazing
I'll hold you a spot at Tuesday's class if you want it
Class tomorrow? I'm making a mug and it already looks like a bucket
Buckets are in this season. I'll be there at 6:30
Bring your claw clip, the clay gets everywhere
It's always in my hair
Fair
My bowl collapsed 😭
Mine did too! Teacher said it's 'a learning experience'
Aka it's garbage
Aka garbage with character 😂
Glaze day! Which color are you going for?
Celadon. Maybe speckled
Ooh nice. I'm doing a deep blue and praying
Pray harder
Pickup is next week, my mug turned out kind of nice??
Can't wait to see it
It's lopsided but it holds coffee. Success
Want to grab brunch after class tomorrow? There's a new place near Alberta
Yes! I'm starving after clay anyway
Pancakes with brown butter. I looked at the menu already
You're a menace 😂
Teacher says the next session starts in June. You in?
I think so. Weddings are packed but evenings are usually okay
Cool I'll sign us up
Thank you!
Do you know any good camera bags? Mine is falling apart
Get one with a padded divider, don't cheap out
Noted. Budget is $100
Then look secondhand. Rose City Camera usually has some
Oh good call
Guess who finally bought a bike
No way. What color?
Mustard yellow. It's hideous and I love it
Send a pic when you're not sweaty
That's never happening
First class of the summer session tonight, are you coming?
So sorry, I'm stuck editing. Rain check?
No worries! I'll save you a wheel
You're the best
Missed you again. Teacher asked where you were
Tell her I'm alive. Just buried in work
I'll tell her. Hope you can come back soon
Me too
Can I borrow your tripod bag for the weekend? Mine's got a broken zipper
Sure, it's in my trunk. I'll leave it on the porch
Thank you!! I owe you a taco
You owe me like 14 tacos at this point
Returned your bag. Left a thank-you note inside 🌮
Found it. The note had a drawing of a taco with legs
His name is Gerald
Gerald is going on my fridge
Okay I just rewatched the whole first season. Your recommendation was correct and I hate that
I'm always correct. Now watch season two
No spoilers!!
My lips are sealed 🤐
Kiln opening was today. Your celadon bowl from spring finally came out, so pretty
Really? I want it!
I'll hold it for you. It's on the shelf with your name
Thank you Jo. Truly
Need a new playlist for the drive to the coast. Send me some of your editing ones
Sending the mellow one. It's mostly piano and dreamy stuff
I will fall asleep at the wheel
Fine, I'll add some bangers. Hang on
Better. Thank you
Back from the coast. Saw a seal. It looked at me like it knew my debts
😂 the seal sees all
Do you want any saltwater taffy? I'm obviously buying 4 pounds
Chocolate-covered anything. You know me
Movie night soon? You pick, I'll bring snacks
I want to. Things are a bit complicated schedule-wise right now
No pressure. Door's open whenever
Thanks, Jo. Really
Cat update: Pickle knocked the plant off the shelf again. Third plant
Pickle is a menace. Mine is currently at a friend's and probably doing worse
Oh yeah, how's Biscuit?
Fat and happy and getting spoiled. Dana sends me pics
Send me one! I need cat content
Later, I'm in the car
Taffy delivery incoming this week. Be home
I'll be at the studio most days. Bring it there
Studio, noted. Is Dana still mad about the lens cap thing?
She'll never let it go 😂
Respect
Also my bike got a flat on day two. Send help
Watch a tutorial, it's a five-minute fix
Rude. Watching one now
Hey, your bowl is still here. Want me to bring it to you or just keep it safe?
Just keep it for now. I'll pick it up soon
Deal. Hope you're okay!
Seal says hi
Rose City Camera Rentals: Your reservation for the 85mm f/1.4 lens is ready for pickup
Thanks, I'll grab it this afternoon
Reminder: your rental is due back tomorrow by 5 PM
Dropping it off at noon
Received. Thanks! Your deposit has been released
Hi Celeste, we have a 24-70 f/2.8 available for the dates you asked about
Yes, please hold it. Pickup the afternoon before
Confirmed. See you then
Your rental reservation for 2 Fuji bodies and a 70-200 lens is confirmed for pickup tomorrow at 8 AM.
Thanks! Can I add a spare battery grip?
Added. Total is updated in your receipt.
Reminder: your gear is due back by 6 PM today.
Running a bit behind, dropping off at 5:30
No problem, we're open until 7.
Rose City Camera Rentals: Your 85mm lens reservation is confirmed for pickup tomorrow after 10 AM.
Thanks! Will grab it around 11.
Rose City Camera Rentals: Reminder, your rental is due back tomorrow by 5 PM.
On it, thanks.
Rose City Camera Rentals: Summer promo, 20% off weekend rentals through August
Nice, thanks for the heads up
Summer deal: 20% off weekend rentals through the end of next month.
Thanks, good to know
We just got the new 16-55 lens in stock if you'd like to try it.
Oh nice, I'll stop by soon
Hi Celeste, Anna Kerr again. Did the proofs for the family portrait come through?
Hi Anna! Yes, gallery link went to your email this morning
Found it. My mom loves the one by the fence
That's my favorite too. Do you want it as an 11x14?
Yes please, two of them
Will order today. Ready in about a week
Prints arrived! They look beautiful, thank you
So glad. Send me a pic of them hung up sometime
Hi Celeste, it's Anna Kerr! Just confirming the timeline for the 11th: hair at 1, ceremony at 4?
Hi Anna! Yes, I'll arrive at 12:30 for getting-ready shots.
Perfect. Mom wants a shot with the grandparents. Is that okay?
Absolutely, it's on the list.
Will do. Also my cousin is engaged, can I pass along your info?
Please do! Tell them to email Northlight and Dana will send the packages
Done. They're excited
Thanks Anna, that means a lot ❤️
Thank you for yesterday!! Everyone loved you. Can't wait to see photos 😭
So happy to hear it! Sneak peek coming in a few days.
Dana will be in touch about the album consult. She'll take good care of you.
Sounds great, thank you!
Eastside Physical Therapy: Hi Celeste, this is a reminder of your evaluation tomorrow at 4:30 PM. Please arrive 10 minutes early to fill out forms.
Thanks, I'll be there
Great. Wear loose clothing for shoulder mobility testing.
Eastside PT: Your plan of care is two visits per week for 6 weeks. Reply YES to confirm the standing appointments.
Can we do one visit a week? Weekends are heavy with shoots
We can start with one visit weekly and add home exercises. Your therapist Maya will send the sheet.
Sounds good. YES to the standing appointment
Confirmed: weekly at 5:15 PM starting next week.
Reminder: your visit is today at 5:15 PM.
Running 10 min late, parking is awful
No problem, Maya will see you when you arrive.
Reminder: your visit is today at 5:15 PM.
Need to cancel today, client moved their engagement session. So sorry
Understood. Would you like to rebook this week? We have a 3:00 PM opening on the 27th.
Yes, 3:00 PM works
Booked. See you then!
Maya: you're doing great. Remember the wall slides, 2 sets of 12 daily, and keep the camera strap on the opposite shoulder when you can.
Switching shoulders is weird but I'll try 😅
Reminder: your visit is today at 5:15 PM.
Your insurance has approved 4 more visits. Would you like to schedule?
Yes, every other week for now. The shoulder feels a lot better
Wonderful. Added: May 19, June 2, June 16, June 30, all at 5:15 PM.
Could we move June 2 to the morning? Something came up
We have 8:30 AM open on June 2. Want it?
Yes thanks
Reminder: you have a PT appointment tomorrow at 8:15 AM. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule.
C
Thanks! See you then. Please wear comfortable clothes.
Your home exercise sheet has been updated. Remember to ice your shoulder after long shoots.
Reminder: your visit is today at 5:15 PM.
That's your last authorized visit. Maya recommends a check-in in 8 weeks. Reply BOOK to schedule.
BOOK

YES
Reminder: appointment tomorrow at 8:15 AM. Reply C to confirm or R to reschedule.
R
No problem. We have an opening in two days at 4:00 PM. Reply Y to book it.
Y
You're booked. See you then!
We haven't seen you in a few weeks. Want to schedule your next session?

Hi Kendra! Thanks for thinking of me. Let me check... yes, I'm open
Wonderful. 120 guests, ceremony at 5, outdoor at a winery in the Willamette Valley
Gorgeous. What's the rain plan?
Covered barn, same venue. Capacity is fine
Perfect. I'll send the contract and a questionnaire today
Thank you! The couple are Maya and Ben, by the way
Love it. I'll get it to them this afternoon
Maya and Ben signed! They want an engagement shoot too, any openings in April?
I have April 11 at golden hour. Laurelhurst Park?
They'll love that. Booking it
I'll send a prep guide on what to wear. Tell them no busy patterns
Ha, Maya's closet is mostly stripes. I'll warn her
They were thrilled with the preview shots!! Maya is already showing her mom
So glad! Full gallery in two weeks
Timeline draft for May 16: getting ready 1:30, first look 3:30, ceremony 5. Does that work?
Looks good. Can we push first look to 3:45? The light on that terrace is better
Done. Updating the vendor sheet
Thanks. Can you confirm who's doing florals?
Wild Stem Florals. You already know them 😉
Love it. Best bouquets in town
Reminder for tomorrow: vendor meal is at 6, parking is behind the barn
Got it. Arriving at 1 with Theo
Perfect. The bride's sister will meet you at the door
Maya and Ben said it was the best day of their lives. Thank you for being so calm
That's the nicest thing! Thank you Kendra
Hi again! Another couple, the Lin-Foster wedding, mid-August, a rooftop downtown. Interested?
Yes, send me the details. Rooftop means wind and sun, so I'll scout
I'll share the venue contact. Scout anytime
Great. Do they want a second shooter?
They'd like one, yes
Theo, then. I'll quote both
Quote approved! Deposit is on the way
Received, thank you. I'll send the questionnaire
Quick heads up, the rooftop has a noise ordinance, music ends at 9:30
Ok. I'll make sure we get the dance floor shots before that
Final guest count is 90. Cake cutting moved up to 7:30
Thanks. I'll update my shot list
All set for next week? The couple asked about a sparkler exit
Sparklers are great but we need a cooldown plan for the venue. Ask if the fire marshal's okay
Will check. Back to you by tomorrow
Thanks Kendra
Your RevoBank verification code is 482915. Do not share this code with anyone.
Your RevoBank verification code is 730268. It expires in 10 minutes.

I have an old carbon one in the studio closet. You can have it
Seriously? That's huge. I'll swing by tomorrow
Dana will be there, she'll hand it over. Ask her about the coffee machine, she's got opinions
Ha. Noted
Got the tripod. Dana made me a latte. Bribery works
She's so scary and so sweet
Still on for the gym this weekend? I want to try that purple route
Can't, I have a shoot. Next time!
Always shooting. Okay, I'll sacrifice my fingers alone
Chalk responsibly 😂
Sent you a photo of the climb. I made it!! (barely)
You look like a spider in a tree. Proud of you
Do you know any good dentists? Imani insists I get a cleaning
Portland Dental Care on Hawthorne. They're gentle and don't judge
Booking now. Thanks
Update: two cavities. Never going to floss again (lie)
Floss. It's not that hard
Okay mom

Morning or afternoon? I'd prefer before noon
11 works for them
See you there. I'll scout the light
Hey, are you free for the Fourth? We're doing a rooftop thing
I'd love to but I have plans. Tell everyone hi
No worries. We'll miss you
Light is rough in that room. Windows face the wrong way
We'll use the side lawn for portraits and bounce light inside
Smart. You're good at this
Trying to be. Thanks for the intro to the couple
Fireworks pic. Some guy dropped a sparkler on his shoe
Oh no. Is he ok?
Just ego damage. He's fine
Hey, are you still looking for a second shooter for the fall rush?
Maybe. Why, you know someone?
A friend of mine, solid portfolio, super chill. I can send her Instagram
Send it over, I'll take a look
Sent. Her name is Kiara, she shoots mostly film
Her work is lovely. I'll ask Dana to check it too
Great. No pressure, just thought of you
The DJ needs a shot list for the first dance. Can you send me yours?
Sure, emailing it now
Got it. Thank you
Did you get the softball team photos back from the print lab?
They're ready, I'll drop them at your place this week
No rush. The team is just excited
Quick question. Would a 24mm lens work for baby photos? Imani wants me to do newborn pics myself
Better with a 50. Wide makes baby heads look huge. Rent one from Rose City
Genius. Thanks
Dropped them in your mailbox. Check for the big envelope
Got them!! Coach is crying, I'm not kidding
Tell her she's welcome 😊
Trail run next weekend? Early, before it's hot
I'm shooting that day. The one after?
Works. 6:30 at the Wildwood trailhead
Ugh, 6:30. Fine. I'm bringing a banana
Elite fuel
Dana told me you moved places. Need help hauling anything?
All good, thanks though. Just a few boxes left
Offer stands. I have a truck and strong forearms from climbing
😂 I'll remember that
Quick one, do you carry a spare memory card? Mine's acting weird
Yes, 128GB. Take it, you can return it later
Saved my morning
Good luck today!
Sorry, bailing on the run. Rough night, barely slept
All good. Rest. Want me to bring you a coffee after?
Sweet of you, but I'm okay. Next time
You've said next time a lot lately. Everything alright?
Just tired. Thanks for asking
Okay. I'm around if you want to talk
I know. Thank you 🙂
Gym opens a new bouldering wall next week. Want to come?
Maybe. Let me see how my week shakes out

messages.title: Forest Park Run Club, Tasha, Sam

msgs.text: Welcome new runners! Weekly trail run meets at the Lower Macleay trailhead, 6:30 AM. All paces welcome.
Hi all! Tasha here. Any other slow runners? 🙋‍♀️
Sam. Slow is the default. We stop for coffee
Celeste, hi! Slow-ish runner. I come for the dirt and the quiet
Welcome Celeste!
Reminder: trail is muddy after rain. Wear shoes you don't love.
Too late, I already love mine
On my way, 10 minutes behind
We'll wait at the first bridge
You are angels
Next run: a 4 mile loop through Wildwood. Water at the Stone House.
I'm in. Sam, are you bringing the dog?
Obviously. Juno is the real athlete
Juno gets the first treat
Race season starts. Anyone doing the 10K at the end of May?
Considering. Pain, but fun
I'll sign up if someone promises to let me walk the hills
Promise. Hills are walking zones
Signed up! Bib pickup is the day before
Okay I'm in. Don't let me quit
Pro tip: shorter strides downhill, quiet breathing uphill. See you at 6:30.
Nice run today, everyone! That sunrise by the Pittock trail 😍
Best sunrise so far. Forgot my camera and am furious at myself
You have a phone
It's not the same!!
10K done. Tasha's sprint finish was unreal
I saw a hill and got angry
Congrats you two! I had a wedding, sorry, bad timing. Next one
We drank a mimosa in your honor
Perfect response
Trail run at Wildwood this morning, meeting at 6:30. Bring water, it's going to be warm
I'll be there with bells on
Running late, start without me
You always say that and then you finish first
Great loop today, everyone. Bagels at the corner place after?
Summer schedule: runs start at 6:00 AM to beat the heat. Same meeting spot.
Why is it so early 😭
Heat is worse
Might skip some. Evenings are tough with work. I'll be back
No pressure, we're here whenever
Heads up: trail closure near the Lower Macleay entrance for maintenance. Use the alternate lot.
Parking is the real trial
Reminder: the club picnic is next month, bring a dish
I'll bring potato salad
Sam, you are NOT bringing store-bought hummus again
It was good hummus
Can't make it this time, work stuff. Have fun!
We'll miss you, Celeste
Forest Park is magical in the morning right now, the ferns are glowing
Wish you were here Celeste 🌲
Miss it. Soon
We'll save you a spot at the bridge
Trail's closed near the lower loop because of fallen trees. Use the upper path
Thanks for the heads up
Reminder: club picnic next month at Laurelhurst. Bring a side dish!
I'm bringing the dog and no side dish
Tasha brings cookies
Cookies sound dangerous. Count me in for the picnic, maybe
Maybe is accepted 😊
Anyone want to sign up for the 10K in the fall?
Maybe. Ask me in a couple weeks
Coucou ma chérie! Maman says you have a new phone number for work. Is this still the right one?
Hi Tante Odile! Same number, I only changed the carrier. Hope you're well 🙂
Very well. The cold here is terrible but the bakery downstairs still saves me a brioche.
Save me one for the next visit
When is the next visit? You promised before the summer.
I know, I know. Wedding season eats everything. Maybe autumn, once things quiet down
Autumn is lovely here. The Saône in October, you remember?
I do. I have like two hundred photos of it somewhere
Happy birthday to my favorite photographer!! 🎂 33 already, mon Dieu.
Merci Tante!! You remembered 🥹
Of course. I mailed a card, it will be late, the post is a disaster.
Card arrived! The little drawing of the cat made me laugh
That is not a cat, it is a lion. I am wounded.
😂 a very small lion then
I am doing a vide-grenier on Sunday. Selling Papa's old camera bag, the leather one. Do you want it first?
YES. Do not sell it. Please. I'll ask Maman to bring it when she visits
Bien sûr. I will put it in a box with the lavender sachets.
Tante, how do I make the tarte tatin your way? Mine is always soggy
You cook the apples too long before the pastry. Less. And a hot pan. And salted butter, always.
Salted butter. Writing it down
Did it work?
Best one I've ever made 🍎 I ate half standing at the counter
That is the correct way to eat it.
My hip is better, the doctor says walking is good. I walk to the market every morning now.
That's wonderful news. Don't overdo it on the cobblestones!
I am careful. I walk like a duchess.
Photo of Maman on the balcony, she looks happy. She says you are very busy and quiet lately.
Busy, yes. I'll call her soon. Tell her I love her?
Tell her yourself, chérie. But I will pass it on too.
Fair 🙂
Ma chérie, how is the work? Are you eating properly?
Bonjour Tante! Yes I'm eating, I promise. Lots of weddings
Good. I made your grand-mère's tarte aux pommes yesterday and thought of you
Stop, now I want some 😭
Come to Lyon in the autumn. I will bake one just for you
I'd love that. Let me see about flights
Your cousin Margaux had a baby girl. Here is the news, so you know
Oh how wonderful!! Please send her my love
I will. Her name is Camille. Very beautiful
Camille, I love it. I'll mail a card
The heat wave started. 38 degrees. I sit with my feet in a bucket and read the whole day.
Stay inside and drink water! Portland is mild this week, I'm jealous
Water, yes. And a little rosé. For the circulation.
For the circulation 😂
The weather here is very hot. Even the cats are complaining
Same here, but I'm used to it from shooting outdoors
Do you still want the lavender soap from the market? I can send a parcel.
Yes please! And the camera bag whenever there's room. I'll pay the postage
No postage. It is a gift. Give me an address.
Let me get back to you on the address, I'm between places this month
Between places? Hm. Tell me when you know. Bisous.
Bisous Tante 🤍
Call your mother more. She worries
I know. I will this week, I promise
Bises, ma belle
Celeste!! Are you free for the Hollywood Theatre thing next month? They're doing a 35mm night
Probably, I'll check the calendar. What's showing?
Some old Truffaut double feature. Very you.
Okay yes. Put me down for two tickets 🎞️
Got them. I'll bring the good popcorn salt.
That was so good. I'm still thinking about the ending
Right?? Also your hair looked amazing tonight
It was the claw clip doing all the work
Do you know a good dentist who takes new patients? Mine retired
Portland Dental Care on Hawthorne, I've been going for years. They're nice and don't lecture about flossing
Perfect. Booking today.
Plant swap at my place this weekend if you want a pothos cutting
I have a wedding all day. Rain check?
Always a wedding 😅 I'll save you one
Okay my pothos is thriving. I named it Gerald
Gerald deserves a good life
Hey, haven't heard from you in a bit. Drinks soon?
Sorry, slammed. Let me look at next week
No stress. Just don't disappear on me 💛
Not disappearing. Promise.
Did the new ramen place on Division open yet? I keep walking past the paper in the windows
Not sure, I haven't been over that way
Do you still have the pottery glaze chart? I forgot which blue I used
Yes, it's on my other phone case. Sending a photo of the page tonight
You're the best
Went anyway. Tonkotsu is elite. We should go
Yes. Soon. I mean it this time
I'll believe it when there's broth in front of me
My landlord wants to raise rent by 200. Is that even legal
Oregon has a cap, look up the statewide limit on the state site. Should be well under that
You are a lifesaver. Looking now.
My bowl came out of the kiln with a crack 😩
Oh no. Kintsugi it. Gold makes everything fancy
Okay that's actually a great idea
Update: he backed down after I sent the link. Thank you!!
Ha! Love that
Class on the 22nd is trimming day. Wear clothes you hate
Already wearing my sacrificial apron
Farmers market tomorrow, peaches are in. Want some?
Yes please, whatever you grab. I'll venmo you

Save me a box for when I visit

Je t'aime. Eat vegetables
The soaps arrived! They smell like your grandmother's closet 😊

I miss your voice. Call me on Sunday?

Je t'embrasse fort

Wine night this week? I have a bottle judging me.

Send a pic
Too ashamed
Class tomorrow?

Wine night? It's been weeks!
I met someone, kind of. Can't tell if it's a story yet
WHAT. Details.
Later 😂
Pottery tonight?
Can't, dinner plans
Ok, next time!
Wine night? I'll bring cheese.

Hey stranger, you alive?

Soon, promise.

Seven? I'll leave work early

New glaze session starts soon. Join?
